points.description: States that a stack is a data structure (or collection) that stores elements. Equivalent wording such as 'a container for items' earns the mark.

States the ordering property: the last item added is the first to be removed, i.e. last-in-first-out (LIFO). Equivalent wording, or the term 'LIFO' with a correct explanation, earns the marks. Saying only 'last-in-first-out' with no explanation is sufficient.
